description: Real-world GitHub Actions workflow corpus for Week 2 evaluation (linter accuracy, round-trip fidelity, field coverage). Sourced live from two active open-source repos via their raw.githubusercontent.com files at the commit noted below.

sources.note: 35 workflow files in .github/workflows at time of fetch; 6 selected for diversity

145 workflow files in .github/workflows at time of fetch (one of the largest, most complex GHA setups on GitHub); 4 selected for diversity. A 5th file (trunk.yml) was attempted but skipped: it exceeded a safe single-fetch size in this session's tooling and risked a truncated/corrupted fixture, so it was left out rather than saved incomplete.
